title: Map Builder sheet scale repair
description:
Some Map Builder PDF sheets were rendering as a tiny drawing in the corner of a huge white page, with highlights/structure overlays stretched across the empty paper. Root cause: page layout size stayed large while viewDispScale was stuck at 1 (or native size was wrongly set equal to the layout box), so the PDF media was not CSS-scaled into the sheet.

Reconcile now forces viewDispScale to match layout÷native crop, recovers inflated native sizes, and first-paint HTML applies the same scale transform. Legacy map rebuild uses the correct map display scale.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync and reopen Map Builder — every sheet should fill its paper box with overlays aligned.
changeLog: Fix Map sheets stuck with viewDispScale=1 inside oversized paper boxes.
Recover native size when it was wrongly set to the layout footprint.
Apply CSS scale on first paint so sheets are not briefly unscaled.
Legacy map scale rebuild uses the intended Map display scale.
